fields.summary_ko.0: AVGO share price rose 4.3% in early November 19 trading, then fell 1.5% as of 2:25 PM, with fluctuation in valuation of $1 billion investment position linked to Anthropic IPO.
fields.summary_ko.1: Anthropic's IPO pricing at $83 opened at $111.50 then adjusted to $97, with AVGO's investment position incurring $385 million loss, valued below 18x net income basis.
